gold.user: User wants to delete a specific media attachment from a message in their Twilio account. They have the AccountSid, MessageSid, and Sid of the media they wish to remove.
gold.ideal: Successfully deletes the specified media attachment and returns a 204 No Content response.

gold.user: User needs to retrieve a specific media attachment associated with a message in their Twilio account. They have the AccountSid, MessageSid, and Sid of the media they want to fetch.
gold.ideal: Returns the media details including URL, content type, and size in a JSON format.
